fit_layout: i_last, llk_final, pic, sigmasq, a, heritability, c0, t_weight, t_pi, t_var (timings are CPU seconds; ignore)

examples_md.note: examples.md prints 7 significant digits, so agreement is limited to ~1e-7 relative

examples_md_calls.note: examples.md passes Sig2s=c(est[3],est[3]) for the 2-component model, i.e. the stratification term a rather than sigmasq (est[2]); both variants are stored

meta.long_double_note: long double == double (64-bit) on this platform; x86 builds use 80-bit extended precision and can differ in the last few digits
meta.openmp_note: real OpenMP: Apple clang -Xclang -fopenmp, omp.h from /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jeya-Documents-projects-GENESIS/41e4a0fe-88e1-4a10-a2bc-95f06a8a1df1/scratchpad/oracle/omp/usr/local/include, libomp.dylib from /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/lib
meta.json_conventions: doubles written with 17 significant digits (exact round-trip); non-finite values are the strings NaN/Inf/-Inf/NA; matrices are row-major arrays of rows
meta.determinism_note: OpenMP reductions over long double with >1 thread: results are reproducible to ~1e-12 relative, not bitwise

printed_trace_note: printed_trace_matrix holds what upstream printed with printfreq=1 (6 significant digits); column 2 is the log-likelihood at the parameters BEFORE that iteration's update
